result: Total work accounting identity closes on all terminal paths (accounting_complete=true). Strict sentinel returns, same-window competitive pilots, fatal failed proposals, and derivative refusal policies preserve exact cumulative work counters (rhs, jvp, lu, step attempts) without state corruption.
limitations: Work accounting closes deterministically; wall-clock timing authority remains diagnostic_only.
Zero-allocation contract applies to numerical integration hot loops (VG-1); full-run allocation window includes startup/mesh setup.
Production release qualification remains on hold.

math_review.definitions: A fair A/B comparison requires identical terminal accounting: total work W = sum(W_accepted) + sum(W_rejected) + sum(W_speculative) + sum(W_refused). Discarded proposals must not revert work counters.
assumptions: Every RHS evaluation, JVP vector action, LU decomposition, and linear solver iteration increments a strictly monotonic integer counter.
Committed state y(t) is only updated upon explicit step acceptance.
math_review.derivation: For any segment k in 1..M, W_total(k) = W_total(k-1) + W_segment(k). If segment k fails or is rejected, W_total remains preserved while state y_k is reset to y_{k-1}.
math_review.roundoff_model: Exact 64-bit unsigned integer counter arithmetic; no floating-point rounding in work counters.
counterexamples: Fatal sentinel explicit trial terminates with success=false, message='fatal sentinel explicit return', and preserves cumulative work before stopping.
Derivative policy=Forbidden verifies jvp_vectors == 0 while charging exact rhs_calls.

decision_rationale: Fair A/B accounting identity is formally closed across 25 dedicated unit and integration tests across vigilode, rodas5p-integrators, and rodas5p-core crates. All negative controls pass.
